p: wide shot of a school debate hall, three stage zones glowing: a podium with gavel, a question-mark bubble, a closing seal, seated human students watching
title card of the word CONSTRUCTIVE, a human young debater at a podium stacking building blocks that represent arguments
a human first debater standing at a podium placing a large solid foundation under the floor, big building blocks, confident gesture
a human debater at a podium, three floating bullet banners above the head showing team position and main reasons
a human second debater leaning forward shooting a thought-arrow toward the opposing team's first debater podium, the target speech bubble cracking
a large magnifying glass scanning a speech bubble made of chain links, one broken weak link glowing red
a human debater laying out three example cards on a table, real and hypothetical examples to support their own side
a human debater split by a vertical line: left half holding a gavel and magnifier (critic), right half placing a brick on a wall (builder)
title card of the word CROSS-EXAMINATION, two human teams across a table exchanging question and answer speech bubbles
diagram: two human affirmative-team debaters on the left, three human negative members on the right, two arrows pointing to all three negatives
diagram mirrored: two human negative-team debaters on the right, three human affirmative members on the left, arrows pointing to all affirmatives
a clipboard checklist titled RULES with one rule highlighted, and a human moderator holding a conductor baton in front of a clock
a human debater holding a timer and a numbered list deciding how many questions and when to switch, a large hourglass with flowing sand
a human questioner pointing one finger directly at a single seated member, targeted question, that member highlighted
the human responding team huddled in a circle looking at each other, one member raising a hand volunteering to answer
a red cross-out over one member's seat, another member standing up to answer instead, the team whispering to choose the best one
two human questioners side by side with a take-turns toggle switching between them, alternating rhythm
two human questioners each holding one or two small question bubbles, with a small just-a-suggestion tag
one human questioner rapid-firing a chain of follow-up question bubbles at the same member, plus a wall clock and a do-not-interrupt sign
title card of the word SUMMARY, a human third debater giving a closing statement under a warm spotlight, team behind in support
a human debater gathering the strongest argument cards into a neat stack under a spotlight
a human debater under a warm spotlight with a rising arrow and applause, addressing the opponent challenges, memorable finale
